Login.UrlContainsAuthLogin: URL must route to the OrangeHRM login page
Login.SubmitButtonVisible: Login submit button must be present
Login.DashboardHeadingVisible: the OrangeHRM dashboard heading must appear after login
Login.LoggedInUsernameVisible: the logged-in user's name must appear in the topbar
Login.SuccessRedirectsToDashboard: a successful login must redirect to the dashboard
Login.ErrorAlertVisible: an error alert must appear for invalid credentials
Login.InvalidCredentialsText: OrangeHRM shows 'Invalid credentials' for wrong username/password

UserManagement.TableVisible: the users table must be visible after navigation
UserManagement.HasAtLeastOneUser: at least one system user must exist
UserManagement.SearchReturnsAdminResult: searching for 'Admin' must return at least the built-in Admin account
UserManagement.RecordsFoundMatchesRows: the records-found span should embed the row count
UserManagement.AddButtonNavigatesToForm: clicking Add must navigate to the save/create user form

Navigation.SystemUsersUrl: navigating to System Users must load the correct page
Navigation.SystemUsersTableRendered: the system-users table must be rendered
Navigation.SystemUsersHasRows: there must be at least one user in the system
Navigation.PimUrl: clicking PIM in the nav must route to the PIM module
Navigation.DashboardUrl: clicking Dashboard must return to the main dashboard
Navigation.DashboardHeading: the page heading must read 'Dashboard' immediately after login
Navigation.LogoutRedirectsToLogin: logout must redirect back to the OrangeHRM login page

ApiUsers.NonEmpty: the API must return at least one user
ApiUsers.CreateIdAssigned: the API should assign an ID to the created resource
ApiUsers.EmailValidFormat: User.Email '{0}' should be a valid email

ApiProjects.UserOwnsAtLeastOne: User ID {0} ({1}) should own at least one project
ApiProjects.UserOneMustExist: user ID 1 must exist before we can link a project to it
ApiProjects.BelongToQueriedUser: all returned projects must belong to the queried user
